twenty-upgrade-source.reason: Runs only inside the maintenance window to drain the queues of the previous release; the current twenty pin is scanned.

postgres-upgrade-source.reason: Runs only in the upgrade test that proves the previous PostgreSQL release data volume starts under the current pin; the current postgres pin is scanned.

redis-upgrade-source.reason: Runs only inside the maintenance window to read the previous queue store; the current valkey pin is scanned.

rustfs-upgrade-source.reason: Runs only in the upgrade test that proves migration from the previous release; the current rustfs pin is scanned.

seaweedfs.reason: Second S3 implementation used only by the object-storage contract test; it is never deployed.

uv.reason: Base of leonaid-api and leonaid-worker; every shipped layer is scanned through those two images.

bun.reason: Build stage and base of the frontend images; every shipped layer is scanned through the leonaid-* images.

typst.reason: Only the typst binary is copied into leonaid-api and leonaid-worker and is scanned there.

python.reason: Runs repository checkers in CI and one campaign-site build stage; the shipped images are scanned instead.

caddy-builder.reason: Compiles the proxy binary; the resulting leonaid-proxy image is scanned.

playwright.reason: Browser test runner for CI and development only; it is never deployed.

syft.reason: SBOM generator that runs in CI only; it is never deployed.

trivy.reason: The image and filesystem vulnerability scanner itself; runs in CI only.

osv-scanner.reason: Lockfile vulnerability scanner that runs in CI only; it is never deployed.

caddy.reason: Runtime base of leonaid-proxy, which is built from it, patched and scanned; the raw image runs only in the observability test compose.

listmonk.reason: Only in the opt-in 'mailing' Compose profile, which no pilot deployment enables. Move it to runtime (scanned) before enabling the profile anywhere.
